The city council voted 6–3 on Tuesday to convert two downtown parking structures into mixed-use housing, citing a vacancy rate above 40 percent since 2021, over opponents' objections that weekend events still fill both garages and that the study behind the vote sampled only weekdays. The conversion is expected to add 310 apartments, a fifth of them below market rate, with construction starting next spring if financing closes.

(Checked sentence-by-sentence against your text: the vote tally, the 40 percent figure and its 2021 start, both opponent arguments, the 310 apartments, the one-fifth below-market share, and the financing contingency are all carried verbatim or as paraphrase; nothing was added or dropped beyond the connective phrasing.)
